profile.headline: Network/Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Currently, I have been working in the Network Automation/Network Management area with python, awx, ansible. The Automation platform is  based on Linux, which is my favorite OS. My network knowledge is initially from the network stack of Linux and FreeBSD.

I worked on SDN/NFV management and test areas and worked as a Test lab with ONF.  Working environments are mainly Linux OS, VM, etc.

Another active project was about the network slice in the 5G system. Network slicing in ONAP is currently a research topic for me.

I am a software and network engineer. The domain of software is related to the network and Internet. Most developed software are routing and packet manipulation.

I experienced software testing. Issue tracking and creating test scenarios, test automations are my interesting areas. Recently I got an ISTQB FL license. - that is the foundation level.

I experienced Dev.board bring-up and device drivers for embedded systems.(based on Linux and VxWorks). Program languages are mostly C, C++,  and Java. Application, network kernel stack and device drivers for previous projects. Last year, I started a Python program for test automations.

Recent network engineering area is network testing. For example, L2 switch testing, L3 switch testing, and SDN testing. I currently manage the testbed for SDN/NFV. I have been experiencing various OS such as Windows 7, NT, Linux, and OSX.

– Software and System Engineer @ Internet Research Group in ETRI, Korea (www.etri.re.kr) (Mar. 2020, Summary) 
- Project: Development of High Speed Router System
- Project: Development of Next Generation Router System Phase I (Jan. 2002 ~ Aug. 2005)
- Project: Development of Multimedia QoS Router System (Jan. 2007 ~ Dec. 2008) / middleware (Spread Toolkit)
- Project: Development of Future Internet Testbed Platform (Jan. 2008 ~ Dec.2010) / Network Processor
- Project: Development of Traffic Management and Analysis Platform based on NFV/SDN  (Jan. 2011 ~ present)
- Project: SDN/NFV Testbed and testing (Jan. 2017 ~present) / Python Network Automation

Network and System Engineer @ Hyundai Motors Group, Seoul, Korea (www.hyundai.com)
- Project: Network Management System for Hyundai Motors.
- Network Configuration Management
- Database Management

patents.title: System and method for guaranteeing quality of service in IP networks
patents.description: The system of the present invention guarantees quality of service with respect to packets transmitted/received between an external network capable of providing differentiated services and a home network. The system includes a packet classifier, a marker, a priority class queue, a scheduler and a token bucket. The packet classifier classifies the packets according to addresses and traffic types. The marker allocates information on priorities to packets transmitted from the home network to the external network. The priority class queue has a plurality of queues classified according to the priorities. The scheduler services packets stored in the priority class queue according to the priorities. The token bucket drops packets, bandwidths of which are above a preset maximum bandwidth, when the packets are generated.
